title: Quercetin Impedes Th17 Cell Differentiation to Mitigate Arthritis Involving PPARgamma-Driven Transactivation of SOCS3 and Redistribution Corepressor SMRT from PPARgamma to STAT3.
authors: Yang, Yan; Shi, Gao-Na; Wu, Xin; Xu, Min; Chen, Cheng-Juan; Zhou, Yu; Wei, Ya-Zi; Wu, Lei; Cui, Fen-Fang; Sun, Lan; Zhang, Tian-Tai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过PPARgamma调控SOCS3/STAT3轴抑制Th17分化以缓解关节炎，虽含分子动力学模拟蛋白-配体结合，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作与细胞信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: SCOPE: Quercetin (QU) is one of the most abundant flavonoids in plants and has attracted the attention of researchers because of its remarkable antirheumatoid arthritis (RA) effects and extremely low adverse reactions. However, the underlying mechanism needs further study. METHODS AND RESULTS: Flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, enzyme linked immunosorbent assay （ELISA）, and quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction （qRT-PCR） reveal the obvious inhibitory effects of QU on Th17 cell differentiation in arthritic mice. More importantly, QU markedly limits the development of Th17 cell polarization, which is virtually compromised by the treatment with peroxisome proliferator activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) inhibitor GW9662 and knockdown of PPARgamma. Additionally, molecular dynamics simulation and immunofluorescence exhibit QU directly binds to PPARgamma and increases PPARgamma nuclear translocation. Besides, QU confers its moderation effect on suppressor of cytokine signaling protein (SOCS3)/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) axis partially depending on PPARgamma. Furthermore, coimmunoprecipitation shows QU redistributes the corepressor silencing mediator for retinoid and thyroid-hormone receptors (SMRT) from PPARgamma to STAT3. Finally, the inhibition of Th17 response and the antiarthritic effect of QU are nullified by GW9662 treatment in arthritic mice. CONCLUSION: QU targets PPARgamma and consequently inhibits Th17 cell differentiation by dual inhibitory activity of STAT3 to exert antiarthritic effect. The findings facilitate its development and put forth a stage for uncovering the mechanism of other naturally occurring compounds with chemical structures similar to QU.
abstract_zh: 范围：槲皮素（QU）是植物中含量最丰富的黄酮类化合物之一，因其显著的抗类风湿关节炎（RA）作用及极低的不良反应而受到研究者的关注。然而，其潜在机制仍需进一步研究。方法与结果：流式细胞术、免疫荧光、酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和定量实时聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）揭示了QU对关节炎小鼠中Th17细胞分化的明显抑制作用。更重要的是，QU显著限制了Th17细胞极化的进程，而这种作用在过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）抑制剂GW9662处理及PPARgamma敲低后几乎被削弱。此外，分子动力学模拟和免疫荧光显示QU直接结合PPARgamma并增加PPARgamma的核转位。另外，QU对细胞因子信号传导抑制蛋白（SOCS3）/信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）轴的调节作用部分依赖于PPARgamma。进一步地，免疫共沉淀显示QU将共抑制因子维甲酸和甲状腺激素受体的沉默介导因子（SMRT）从PPARgamma重新分布至STAT3。最后，在关节炎小鼠中，GW9662处理消除了QU对Th17反应的抑制及其抗关节炎作用。结论：QU靶向PPARgamma，并通过STAT3的双重抑制活性抑制Th17细胞分化，从而发挥抗关节炎作用。这些发现促进了其开发，并为揭示其他与QU化学结构相似的天然化合物的机制提供了平台。
